raw:
These 30 hypotheses cover the four gaps. Most rest on three mechanisms: a skip or conv on edge 3 already supplies a residual path, so it should shrink the gain from upgrading edges 4 or 5. Adding capacity to a path that an upstream `none` has severed has no effect. Edits that replace `none` should gain more than edits that replace an existing op. I did not run any of these against the benchmark.
